title: Exact parcel binding and postcode lifecycle
official_findings: January 2026 BDUK sample exposes separate UPRN, postcode, subsidy status, current_gigabit, future_gigabit and intervention fields.
ONSPD May 2026 links current and terminated postcodes to geography and was last updated 10 June 2026.
ONS warns centroid allocation can misallocate boundary-straddling postcode data and postcodes can be recoded/reused.
Repository indexed searches did not surface a trusted exact parcel-to-UPRN binding artifact; this absence is not treated as NO_DATA.
Row promotion therefore still requires verified identity, currentness and epoch provenance.
